trajectory.thought: The leader (median of full pool) is a seeded baseline and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable. With unstable rankings, correlated errors, and only 3 validation windows, the robust median is well-suited to this strongly trending, seasonal series, and further tuning is unlikely to produce a real gain over noise.

action_args.justification: The series has very strong trend (0.9998) and seasonality (1.0) with unstable model rankings (Kendall tau 0.181) and correlated error groups. A robust median over the full pool naturally down-weights outlying models without overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows, and the leader's margin over the runner-up is not statistically distinguishable, so accepting the seed is the right call.
